description: Sets up Cosend’s “Welcome and away menu” automation on one WhatsApp number: Greets new customers, and anyone who writes while you are closed, with buttons for quick answers or a person. Its settings are this recipe’s own, as its set-up form in Cosend asks them; a setting left out takes its default. It is set up switched off, and acts only once it is switched on. The same recipe is set up once on each number, or once per source when it asks for one. The preview refuses a second one as the save would, and gives no token. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the automation, switched off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

name.description: Its name in Cosend. Left out, it takes the recipe’s name.

settings.description: The recipe’s settings, as its set-up form asks them. A setting left out takes its default; a setting with no default is needed.

answer_1.default: We are open Monday to Friday, from 9:00 to 18:00.
answer_1.description: Say your opening days and hours here.
answer_1.title: Button 1 answer

answer_2.default: Prices depend on what you need. Tell us a little more and we will reply with a quote.
answer_2.title: Button 2 answer

away_text.default: Thanks for your message. We are closed right now and will reply from {opens}.
away_text.description: Sent outside your hours, with the buttons that are on. Where it says {opens}, the customer reads when you next open.
away_text.title: Away message

greeting.default: Hi, thanks for getting in touch. How can we help?
greeting.description: Sent on a first message, with the buttons that are on.
greeting.title: Welcome message

person_answer.default: Thanks, someone from our team will reply here as soon as they can.
person_answer.title: What it says when it hands over

person_button_on.description: Hands the chat to a person.
person_button_on.title: Button 3

name: set_up_welcome_menu
title: Set up “Welcome and away menu”
